Maruti Suzuki Hansalpur EV Plant Expanded
: Maruti Suzuki began production at a new Hansalpur EV plant in Gujarat. Rs3,900 crore investment adds 250,000 EVs capacity, raising Hansalpur to 1M and group capacity to 2.9M vehicles.
Maruti Suzuki Price Hike Up To ₹20,000
: Maruti Suzuki (MARUTI) raised prices up to ₹20,000 on select models from September 2026. It's the third hike since May; firm cites inflation and rising costs as drivers.
Maruti Suzuki Baleno Facelift: New Engine, ADAS
: Maruti Suzuki (MARUTI) facelifted Baleno gains 1.2L Z12E engine: petrol MT 23.80 kmpl, AMT 24.77 kmpl; CNG 30.61 km/kg. Adds weight, Level-2 ADAS and styling. Starting ~Rs 6.10 lakh.
